method: Stable-release bootstrap, stage-two/stage-three assembly equality. One warm-up per configuration, three measured cycles, reversed order on odd cycles. Control own source equals common source. No concurrent builds/tests during timing. Linux CLOCK_MONOTONIC_RAW includes assembly/linking. Common source includes the complete control compiler and library. No excluded source.

source_counts.method: Physical lines in tracked .casa files. compiler is compiler/*.casa recursively, consumers are casa.casa/lsp.casa/formatter/format.casa, compiler_tests is tests/compiler/**/*.casa. Hash is SHA-256 over sorted path, NUL, content, NUL. Private .inc fixture counted separately. No generated output or runtime relocation.

measurement_driver:
from pathlib import Path
import json,subprocess
root=Path('/home/ai-agent/git/casa-715');evidence=Path('/tmp/casa715-final');out=evidence/'measurements'
script=root/'docs/benchmarks/fixed-point-compilation/measure.py'
configs=[('control-common',evidence/'control/stage3',evidence/'control-source'),('candidate-common',evidence/'candidate/stage3',evidence/'control-source'),('candidate-own',evidence/'candidate/stage3',root)]
for number in range(4):
 for name,compiler,source in (configs if number%2==0 else list(reversed(configs))):
  label=f'{name}-warmup' if number==0 else f'{name}-{number}'
  with (out/f'{label}.measurement.log').open('w') as log:
   subprocess.run(['python3',str(script),label,str(compiler),str(source),str(out)],stdout=log,stderr=subprocess.STDOUT,check=True)
  record=json.loads((out/f'{label}.json').read_text())
  print(label,round(record['elapsed_seconds']['monotonic_raw'],3),record['gnu_time']['peak_rss_kib'],flush=True)
lifetime_driver:
from pathlib import Path
import subprocess,json
root=Path('/home/ai-agent/git/casa-715'); evidence=Path('/tmp/casa715-final')
compiler=evidence/'candidate/stage3'; sampler=root/'docs/benchmarks/compiler-reductions/lifetime.py'
workloads={'frontend':'compiler-reductions/lifetime.casa','backend':'compiler-reductions/backend-lifetime.casa','editor':'editor-snapshots/lifetime.casa','workspace':'workspace-snapshots/lifetime.casa'}
records=[]
for name,source in workloads.items():
 binary=evidence/f'lifetime-{name}'
 command=[str(compiler),'-L',str(root/'lib'),str(root/'docs/benchmarks'/source),'-o',str(binary)]
 with (evidence/f'lifetime-{name}.log').open('w') as log:
  subprocess.run(command,cwd=root,stdout=log,stderr=subprocess.STDOUT,check=True)
 sample_command=['python3',str(sampler),str(binary),str(evidence/f'lifetime-{name}.json')]
 subprocess.run(sample_command,cwd=root,check=True)
 records.append({'workload':name,'build_command':command,'sample_command':sample_command})
 print(f'{name} lifetime passed',flush=True)
(evidence/'lifetime-commands.json').write_text(json.dumps(records,indent=2)+'\n')
